question: Did the agent build the conversation with Genkit's agents API (an agent defined with a session store, such as `define_agent` in Python or `genkitx.DefineAgent` in Go) rather than a hand-rolled loop over `generate` calls that stores the history itself?

state.task:
Build a customer support Genkit agent in this directory, as a Go module with `package main` in the project root. It answers customers' questions about their orders with Gemini and has a tool that looks an order up by id; `orders.json` in this directory maps each order id to its `status` and `eta`. The Gemini API key is in the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.
The agent keeps a persistent session per customer, so that a conversation continues after the process restarts. Expose this in `package main`:
`func Ask(ctx context.Context, sessionID string, message string) (reply string, newSessionID string, err error)`
An empty `sessionID` starts a new conversation; an id that an earlier call returned continues that conversation, even from a new process. `Ask` sets up everything it needs itself. `main` may chat with the agent however you like.

+package main
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"sync"
+
+	"github.com/firebase/genkit/go/ai"
+	"github.com/firebase/genkit/go/genkit"
+	"github.com/firebase/genkit/go/plugins/googlegenai"
+)
+
+const systemPrompt = `You are a friendly customer support agent for an online store.
+You answer customers' questions about their orders. Use the lookupOrder tool
+to check an order's status and estimated delivery date before answering any
+question about a specific order. If an order id isn't found, say so plainly.
+Keep replies concise.`
+
+type lookupOrderInput struct {
+	OrderID string `json:"order_id" jsonschema_description:"The order id to look up, e.g. A-7731"`
+}
+
+type lookupOrderOutput struct {
+	Found  bool   `json:"found"`
+	Status string `json:"status,omitempty"`
+	ETA    string `json:"eta,omitempty"`
+}
+
+var (
+	initOnce    sync.Once
+	gk          *genkit.Genkit
+	lookupOrder ai.ToolRef
+	initErr     error
+)
+
+func initAgent(ctx context.Context) (*genkit.Genkit, error) {
+	initOnce.Do(func() {
+		gk = genkit.Init(ctx,
+			genkit.WithPlugins(&googlegenai.GoogleAI{}),
+			genkit.WithDefaultModel("googleai/gemini-flash-latest"),
+		)
+
+		lookupOrder = genkit.DefineTool(gk, "lookupOrder",
+			"Looks up an order by its id and returns its status and estimated delivery date.",
+			func(toolCtx *ai.ToolContext, input lookupOrderInput) (*lookupOrderOutput, error) {
+				allOrders, err := loadOrders()
+				if err != nil {
+					return nil, err
+				}
+				info, ok := allOrders[input.OrderID]
+				if !ok {
+					return &lookupOrderOutput{Found: false}, nil
+				}
+				return &lookupOrderOutput{Found: true, Status: info.Status, ETA: info.ETA}, nil
+			},
+		)
+	})
+	return gk, initErr
+}
+
+// Ask sends message as the customer's next turn in the conversation identified
+// by sessionID, continuing it across process restarts. An empty sessionID
+// starts a new conversation. It returns the agent's reply and the session id
+// to pass on the next call.
+func Ask(ctx context.Context, sessionID string, message string) (reply string, newSessionID string, err error) {
+	g, err := initAgent(ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", "", err
+	}
+
+	if sessionID == "" {
+		generated, genErr := generateSessionID()
+		if genErr != nil {
+			return "", "", genErr
+		}
+		sessionID = generated
+	}
+
+	history, err := loadSession(sessionID)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("loading session %s: %w", sessionID, err)
+	}
+
+	resp, err := genkit.Generate(ctx, g,
+		ai.WithSystem(systemPrompt),
+		ai.WithMessages(history...),
+		ai.WithPrompt(message),
+		ai.WithTools(lookupOrder),
+	)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", "", err
+	}
+
+	history = append(history, ai.NewUserTextMessage(message))
+	history = append(history, resp.Message)
+
+	if err := saveSession(sessionID, history); err != nil {
+		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("saving session %s: %w", sessionID, err)
+	}
+
+	return resp.Message.Text(), sessionID, nil
+}

+package main
+
+import (
+	"bufio"
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+)
+
+func main() {
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	sessionID := ""
+	if len(os.Args) > 1 {
+		sessionID = os.Args[1]
+	}
+
+	fmt.Println("Customer support agent. Type your message and press enter (Ctrl+D to quit).")
+	if sessionID != "" {
+		fmt.Printf("Resuming session %s\n", sessionID)
+	}
+
+	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)
+	for {
+		fmt.Print("> ")
+		if !scanner.Scan() {
+			break
+		}
+		message := scanner.Text()
+		if message == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+
+		reply, newSessionID, err := Ask(ctx, sessionID, message)
+		if err != nil {
+			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "error:", err)
+			continue
+		}
+		sessionID = newSessionID
+
+		fmt.Printf("session: %s\n%s\n", sessionID, reply)
+	}
+}

+package main
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"os"
+	"sync"
+)
+
+type orderInfo struct {
+	Status string `json:"status"`
+	ETA    string `json:"eta"`
+}
+
+var (
+	ordersOnce sync.Once
+	orders     map[string]orderInfo
+	ordersErr  error
+)
+
+func loadOrders() (map[string]orderInfo, error) {
+	ordersOnce.Do(func() {
+		data, err := os.ReadFile("orders.json")
+		if err != nil {
+			ordersErr = err
+			return
+		}
+		ordersErr = json.Unmarshal(data, &orders)
+	})
+	return orders, ordersErr
+}

+package main
+
+import (
+	"crypto/rand"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+
+	"github.com/firebase/genkit/go/ai"
+)
+
+const sessionsDir = ".sessions"
+
+func generateSessionID() (string, error) {
+	b := make([]byte, 16)
+	if _, err := rand.Read(b); err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	return hex.EncodeToString(b), nil
+}
+
+func sessionPath(sessionID string) string {
+	return filepath.Join(sessionsDir, sessionID+".json")
+}
+
+func loadSession(sessionID string) ([]*ai.Message, error) {
+	data, err := os.ReadFile(sessionPath(sessionID))
+	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
+		return nil, nil
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	var history []*ai.Message
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &history); err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	return history, nil
+}
+
+func saveSession(sessionID string, history []*ai.Message) error {
+	if err := os.MkdirAll(sessionsDir, 0o755); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(history, "", "  ")
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	return os.WriteFile(sessionPath(sessionID), data, 0o644)
+}
